decision.reason: ResponsibilityPlan draft, revise and freeze authority exists, but structural coverage is coupled to an incomplete agent-only readiness check; no exact assignee resolver, frozen-plan successor, runtime assignment authority or takeover decision authority exists

authorityRefresh.hardBoundary: No Agent is runnable and no real CapabilityBinding exists

committedAipFacts.responsibilityPlan: tenant-scoped create, list, get, draft revise and freeze with idempotency or expected-version CAS
committedAipFacts.slotShape: slotId, responsibilityType, required capability IDs, input/output refs, gate refs, return stage and AssigneeRef
committedAipFacts.protectedMerge: independent_review, hard_compliance, external_publication_approval and receipt_reconciliation cannot be merged
committedAipFacts.currentAssigneeKinds: public DTO declares multiple kinds but the committed store rejects every non-agent_instance assignee
committedAipFacts.currentReadiness: checks exact AgentInstance version and active SkillBinding, then intersects required capability IDs with tenant-wide active healthy CapabilityBindings
committedAipFacts.bindingOwnershipDefect: the current readiness query does not prove that each active healthy CapabilityBinding belongs to the selected assignee, account, tool or provider
committedAipFacts.frozenRevisionBoundary: only draft ResponsibilityPlan may be revised; there is no canonical successor or reassign command for a frozen plan
committedAipFacts.missingRuntimeAuthority: no AssigneeResolutionReceipt, ResponsibilityAssignmentRevision, TakeoverDecisionReceipt or task or stage owner fence authority was found

ownershipDecision.structuralPlan: ResponsibilityPlanRevision owns required slots, protected separation and chosen assignee refs for a production context
ownershipDecision.structuralCoverage: coverage means every required slot has a structurally valid exact assignment and merge policy; it does not mean any assignee is runnable now
ownershipDecision.operationalReadiness: AssigneeResolutionReceipt owns candidates, rejected reason codes, selected exact AssigneeBinding, capability and policy refs, health, capacity, observedAt and expiry
ownershipDecision.preStartReassign: before TaskRun creation, reassign creates an explicit successor ResponsibilityPlanRevision with supersedes ref, Diff, actor, reason and CAS; a frozen revision remains immutable
ownershipDecision.runtimeTakeover: after TaskRun or Stage attempt exists, takeover creates TakeoverDecisionReceipt and a new execution assignment lease or fence; it does not rewrite the frozen ResponsibilityPlan or Handoff transport
ownershipDecision.handoffBoundary: Handoff carries scoped context only; accepted Handoff does not transfer ownership and reassign does not imply Handoff accepted
ownershipDecision.humanControl: independent review, hard compliance, external publication approval and receipt reconciliation remain separate responsibilities even when one Agent executes multiple ordinary slots

requiredGreenEvidence: signed installed ResponsibilityTemplate exact resolver and eight-Module coverage
human, AgentInstance, ToolBinding and ProviderCapabilityBinding resolution either fully supported or removed from the published contract
selected assignee is bound to every required exact capability and policy, not merely sharing a tenant with an unrelated healthy binding
structural coverage and operational readiness are separately returned and separately displayed
deterministic candidate ordering, rejection reason codes, observedAt, expiry, capacity and Receipt hash
frozen-plan successor and pre-start reassign CAS with immutable prior revisions
runtime takeover maker-checker, separation policy, active lease, fence, checkpoint and provider-unknown gates
old owner writes fail after fence advances and unknown provider effects reconcile before takeover
org-org positive flow, dev-org isolation, refresh reconstruction and concurrent operator tests
